# Success

## Definition of done

Competition or success of the project will be governed by three main conditions: (1) The RMT v. 2.0.0 is uploaded on CRAN free of errors and operating on all main operating systems; (2) Test units are covered 85% or higher as measured by `covr`, and (3)  RMT toolset documentation `pkgdown` and vignettes are publicly available online for user access and assistance

## Measuring success

Success of this project will be defined by:
- **Technical Quality**: Meaning zero `R CMD check` warnings or notes on CRAN builds 
- **Community Outreach**: CRAN package download metrics documented, increase in GitHub repository stars and watchers, and issue tracker engagement from external users.

## Future work

Following the initial CRAN release of v2.0.0, of RMT will expand to include an interactive R Shiny graphical interface `shiny` for non-programmer users and expand data integration for international reliability research databases.
